leadText: Preview (Japanese: エピソード・ゼラオラ予告編 Episode Zeraora Preview) is a chapter in Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story. It was released as preview for the manga before it officially began its serialization. As such, the events of this chapter are merely an abridged version of the actual first chapter.
